description: This file defines a report parser class for generating special message invoices in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for retrieving messages and invoice line details.

classes.name: account_invoice_with_message
classes.description: A report parser class for handling invoice reports with special messages.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with time, message, and invoice line methods.

methods.name: spcl_msg
methods.description: Retrieves a specific notification message based on form data.

methods.name: invoice_lines
methods.description: Generates a detailed list of invoice lines with tax info, quantities, prices, and formatting for report rendering.
